name: commitclerk
blurb: Better git commit messages in one command. It reads your staged diff, asks an LLM for a Conventional Commits message, shows it to you, and commits.

name: Claude Code Tray
blurb: Your Claude Code usage, always in the tray. A native Windows monitor that shows your rate-limit percentage as a crisp, DPI-aware icon.
